candidates.name: Drug-induced Stevens-Johnson syndrome
support_spans: Two days after starting ciprofloxacin, he developed generalized pruritus that progressed to fluid-filled rashes.
Dermatologic examination showed multiple generalized vesicles and bullae with non-hemorrhagic crusts over the trunk and extremities (palms and soles spared).
candidates.why: The patient developed a rash and mucosal findings after starting ciprofloxacin, which is a common cause of Stevens-Johnson syndrome.

candidates.name: Viral hepatitis
support_spans: 7 days of yellow scleral discoloration

AST 283 U/L, ALT 246 U/L
candidates.why: The patient has jaundice and significantly elevated liver enzymes, which are consistent with viral hepatitis.
